title: Yakiniku Party
paragraphs: “Ugh…”
“They’re in no shape to eat right now, are they?”
“But Father went through the trouble of cooking for us. Come on, Ren, Itsuki, eat up!”
“Ugh… I feel sick, and now I’m about to be force-fed some stinky meat… This is a nightmare…”
“Why are you trying to force them to eat?! Well… we haven’t cooked it yet, so let’s wait and see how they feel first.”

Father scolded me. Afterward, Éclair and Father continued taking care of them, regularly swapping out cool towels. After about an hour, Ren and Itsuki had somewhat recovered. Surprisingly, they bounced back pretty fast. I guess that’s what makes them heroes.
“Seriously, I thought I was gonna die so many times!”
“I know, right? The ride was unbelievably rough!”
“Gua!”
Oh, look! Yuki-chan and the others just raised their right wings in unison, striking a pose. I think I can see veins popping on Ren and Itsuki’s heads.
“Don’t act all smug about it!”
“Are you guys trying to kill us by giving us a ride?!”
“‘Kill us by giving us a ride’… That’s quite the phrase. Never heard that one before.”
“How rude! Yuki-chan and the others are doing this out of kindness!”

This is part of Father’s traditional boot camp, the same method that’s trained countless subordinates in the past. No one who has endured this has ever failed to grow stronger. That means Ren and Itsuki will soon see improvements too. Even Keel went through it.
“Anyway, how was the level grinding for you two? I leveled up a bit.”
“Hmm… Well, yeah, we did get a decent boost in just two hours.”
“Yes, if we can gain this much in only two hours, then it’s definitely worth it…”
Ren and Itsuki exchanged weary glances.
Exactly. This is the best way to level up quickly.
“I really don’t want tomorrow to come.”
“Me neither.”
“Was the ride really that bad?”

There’s a clear gap in perception between Ren and Itsuki versus Father. Father has no issue riding Filolials, and when I first rode one, it felt like a dream too. That difference in experience can’t be bridged.
“You’ll get used to it soon enough. Otherwise, you’ll be in trouble down the road.”
“It’s like getting used to motion sickness. You’ll adjust. Not that I’ve ever experienced it myself.”
“Naofumi-san, are you good with transportation?”
“I’ve never really had an issue with it.”

Now that I think about it, in the previous loop—or maybe the one before that—he mentioned that he had never gotten seasick. Apparently, reading books on buses and trains was just part of his daily routine. He even studied and made potions inside Filo-tan’s carriage. That’s some serious talent. He never wastes time.
“Honestly, I’ve never been more envious of you, Naofumi-san.”
“That much?”
“It’s practically a superpower. This doesn’t exist in your world, does it?”
“Never heard of it.”
“Ah, in the first world, Itsuki analyzed that Father might have a special ability.”
I remember that. He claimed that Father’s inability to enjoy the dreamlike comfort of a Filolial’s ride was due to a special ability.
“He’s also incredibly resistant to alcohol, right?”
“So he has an ability that nullifies intoxication… I suppose it’s possible that such a thing exists but has never been fully explored.”
“Guh…”
Hearing that, Ren groaned in frustration.
“Look, I’m not even aware of it myself, so I don’t know why you’re all looking at me like that.”
“Still, the fact that you’ll never experience motion sickness in your life is just unfair!”
“I mean… what do you want me to do about it?”
Father seemed troubled by Ren’s unreasonable complaint. If I recall correctly, Itsuki has some kind of accuracy-related ability. So when you think about it, he really has no right to complain.
“In return, Father takes care of all sorts of miscellaneous tasks for us.”
“Huh?! Hold on, I never agreed to that. Motoyasu-kun, are you seriously planning to keep making me do all the cooking and chores?”
“Do you dislike it?”
“Ugh… Well, if everyone wants me to, I guess I don’t mind…”
“Father has a real talent for homemaking. Now then, Ren, Itsuki, savor the meal Father prepared for you. Or would you prefer a bath instead?”
The bath is already prepared.
“Orrrr, would you rather cuddle up with Yuki-chan and the others under the night sky? The stars are beautiful tonight.”
“Why are you talking like a creepy newlywed?!”
Itsuki glared at me with half-lidded eyes.
Did I say something strange? I think it’s the perfect setup.
“You want us to camp out in this eerie place while distant, ominous howls echo in the background? Let’s just eat and head back to the inn.”
“…Yeah, but I still feel sick. I can’t stand up properly yet.”
“So, are you going to skip dinner and just sleep? What about the bath…?”
“No way. Even if I have to drag my heavy body, I’m getting in that bath. It should help shake off this nausea.”
With that, Ren unsteadily got to his feet and made his way toward the steaming bath I had prepared.
“Yeah, I feel all sticky and gross. At the very least, I need a bath.”
Itsuki, too. He seems like the type who values cleanliness. Well, he does have a bit of a narcissistic streak. Ah, but so does Ren. Oh, right. I was in the middle of making smoked meat.
…Should I build another kiln and shape it like a cow? A little bit of sculpting fun. Hahaha, this reminds me of Smoked Meat from the first world.
“Shall I tell everyone the story of that cow?”

Perhaps the best time to do so is while we’re eating smoked meat. The taste of victory. Speaking of which, along with Smoked Meat, we’ve also gotten rid of those enemies—those pig-like beasts who were once Ren and Itsuki’s comrades. It might be satisfying to talk about how they eventually met their end. Just as I was about to bring it up, I noticed the conversation had already started.
“Phew… So much has happened, and with all the constant tension, I suddenly feel exhausted…”
“Even when we were just waiting in the room, we were on edge.”
“Not that this open-air bath under the starry sky makes it any easier to relax.”
“Yuki-chan and the others are protecting us.”
Indeed, Yuki-chan and the others have formed a defensive formation, keeping watch around the camp. This is the very essence of a Filolial’s territorial instincts.
“No, no, they’re just devouring the meat Naofumi-san prepared!”
“Gua!”
“Don’t just ‘Gua!’ at me!”
“Pets resemble their owners. They’re just as free-spirited as Motoyasu!”
Ren and Itsuki pointed at me from the bathtub. How rude.
Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan all have their own unique personalities!
“Ahaha…”
Father let out a wry laugh as he shared a bit of meat with Yuki-chan and the others. The barbecue party had already begun.
“Alright, I’ll give you two some as well.”
Father placed the grilled meat on small plates and handed them to Ren and Itsuki, who were soaking in the stone bath. Despite their grumbling, they reluctantly took a bite.
“Oh? It has a strong gamey smell, but when you’re hungry, it actually tastes good.”
“Yeah, it’s surprisingly tender. This is wild monster meat, right? I always heard that kind of meat is tough and unpleasant.”
“Father made sure to cut the tendons thoroughly, so even wild meat tastes delicious.”
“Well… I also picked out the best cuts. Yuki-chan and the others are eating the leftovers.”
“Hmm, that makes me feel a little better about it.”
“Yeah, we’re being treated quite well.”
Hmph… I feel like they’re looking down on the Filolials. And they’re not showing enough gratitude to Father.
“Motoyasu-kun, it’s fine. This is my way of thanking them… for trusting me. Next time, you guys can prepare your own food.”
Father said this with a gentle smile. What incredible kindness. We should all be grateful for his boundless generosity and sincerity.
“Hmph… If this is our reward for trusting Naofumi, I can’t really complain.”
“Yeah, compared to being used as mere pawns, this feels much more genuine.”
Saying that, Ren and Itsuki looked up at the starry sky, a faint smile on their faces.
“Kitamura-dono! Don’t get distracted while making the smoked meat!”

Éclair, who was keeping watch and tending the fire, scolded me, ruining the moment. And so, we finished our late-night riverside barbecue and returned to the inn for a well-deserved rest. For the record, after escorting us back, Yuki-chan and the others slept by the riverside.
